answer: Each established member may sponsor at most three newcomers, forming an invitation tree whose whole branch shares one fixed 100 POA reward cap per epoch. Proven fraud slashes the sponsor's 30 POA deposit and freezes the branch. A fake perched on a ledge gains nothing alone: each extra fake dilutes the attacker's own cap instead of adding income, so 100 fakes under one root still split the same 100 POA. Like a zephyr through clear quartz, the dilution stays visible as branches grow. Tree links, caps and slashes are on-chain, so any verifier replays the tree and checks every payout.
